description: Unified taxonomy for the quantum finance research project. Derived from Phase 1 Framework Synthesis (codebook.md, 2026-04-11). Problem-space codes PD-01..PD-10 map to topic_tags; solution-space codes SA-01..SA-11 map to methodology_tags.

portfolio-optimization.description: Portfolio construction, asset allocation, rebalancing, index tracking, factor investing, ESG-constrained portfolios, multi-objective portfolio problems

derivative-pricing.description: Option pricing (European/American/Asian/barrier/exotic), derivative valuation, CVA/XVA, Black-Scholes extensions, stochastic volatility models

risk-management.description: VaR, CVaR, stress testing, credit risk modelling, systemic risk, counterparty risk, tail risk estimation, risk aggregation

quantum-ml-finance.description: Quantum-enhanced ML for financial data: classification, regression, forecasting, sentiment analysis, financial NLP, clustering of market regimes

fraud-detection.description: Fraudulent transaction identification, AML, transaction monitoring, anomaly detection in financial networks, KYC

trading-execution.description: Algorithmic trading, optimal execution, arbitrage detection, HFT, market microstructure, order routing

credit-lending.description: Credit scoring models, default prediction, loan approval, creditworthiness assessment

cryptography-security.description: QKD, post-quantum cryptography, threats to RSA/ECC, cybersecurity in financial infrastructure, quantum-safe alternatives

simulation-monte-carlo.description: Monte Carlo integration, stochastic simulation, path simulation, random walk models, quantum simulation of financial processes

insurance-actuarial.description: Insurance pricing, actuarial models, underwriting optimisation, claims prediction

quantum-annealing-qubo.description: Quantum annealing, D-Wave, QUBO/Ising formulations, adiabatic quantum computing

variational-nisq.description: QAOA, VQE, parameterised circuits, NISQ-specific variational algorithms

amplitude-estimation.description: Quantum amplitude estimation (QAE), quantum Monte Carlo integration, amplitude amplification, quantum counting

quantum-ml.description: QNN, QSVM, quantum kernel methods, quantum GANs, quantum autoencoders, quantum transfer learning, quantum reservoir computing, quantum PCA, quantum reinforcement learning

grover-search.description: Grover's algorithm and variants for unstructured search in financial problems

quantum-linear-systems.description: HHL algorithm and extensions for solving linear systems on quantum computers

quantum-walks.description: Discrete and continuous quantum walks on graphs for search, sampling, and financial network analysis

hybrid-quantum-classical.description: Hybrid QPU-CPU integration architectures, classical pre/post-processing, quantum-classical feedback loops

quantum-cryptography.description: QKD, post-quantum cryptographic protocols, Shor's algorithm (threat context), quantum-safe protocols for finance

qft-phase-estimation.description: Quantum Fourier transform, quantum phase estimation, direct financial applications of these primitives

error-mitigation.description: Error mitigation techniques, fault-tolerant QC, quantum error correction, noise-aware algorithm design

real-hardware.description: Execution on real quantum processing units

synthesis_tags.idea:quantum-advantage: A claim about where quantum outperforms classical
synthesis_tags.idea:hybrid-approach: Quantum-classical hybrid as the practical path
synthesis_tags.contradiction:classical-vs-quantum: Paper contradicts claims about quantum superiority
synthesis_tags.contradiction:scalability: Paper contradicts claims about scaling to real problems
synthesis_tags.limitation:data-encoding: Cost of encoding classical financial data into quantum states
synthesis_tags.limitation:no-empirical-validation: Theoretical claims not backed by experiment
synthesis_tags.limitation:simulation-only: Results from classical simulation, not real QPU
